_about: Curated CORDIS DET queries for European Innovation Ecosystems (EIE) call subjects, keyed by the subject the tagger looks up (Call.topic_title where present, else the call title / Call.name). Subjects auto-extracted verbatim from the work-programme JSON, queries AI-authored + adversarially verified in the contenttype=project phrase-quoted style of cluster_1.json/cluster_3.json. CORDIS indexes EU RESEARCH projects (FP1-Horizon Europe); for non-research calls (and broad funding instruments such as ERC/MSCA) these find thematically related research, so a call's tags are the research fields of related funded projects, NOT its official scope. Re-run POST /cordis/tag-calls {"source":"eie"} to apply.

queries.European Startup and Scaleup Hubs pilot: contenttype=project AND ("startup" OR "start-up" OR "scaleup" OR "scale-up") AND ("innovation ecosystem" OR "innovation hub" OR "entrepreneurship" OR "high-growth firms")
queries.European network of national competence: contenttype=project AND ("innovation procurement" OR "public procurement of innovation" OR "pre-commercial procurement") AND ("competence centre" OR "competence centres" OR "capacity building" OR "public administration")
queries.Expanding Investment Ecosystems: contenttype=project AND ("venture capital" OR "access to finance" OR "risk finance" OR "investment") AND ("innovation ecosystem" OR "deep tech" OR "scale-up" OR "startup")
queries.From lab to market: Strengthening the ro: contenttype=project AND ("technology transfer" OR "technology transfer office" OR "knowledge transfer" OR "knowledge valorisation") AND ("research commercialisation" OR "academic spin-off" OR "university-industry" OR "market uptake")
queries.Scaling up deep tech ecosystems: contenttype=project AND ("deep tech" OR "deep technology" OR "breakthrough innovation") AND ("innovation ecosystem" OR "scaling up" OR "startup" OR "technology commercialisation")
